outputs.expr: () => { const m = document.querySelector('#workspace'); if (!m || !m.dataset.sessionId) return null; return {session_id: m.dataset.sessionId, stage: m.dataset.stage, revision: parseInt(m.dataset.revision, 10), submitted: m.dataset.submitted === 'true', selected: Object.fromEntries(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#receipt [data-slot]')).map(el => [el.dataset.slot, el.dataset.selectionId]))}; }
